abstract: Mouse teratocarcinoma stem cells (embryonal carcinoma, or EC cells) bind very small amounts of mouse epidermal growth factor (EGF) and the latter hormone seems to have no stimulatory effect on the growth of two cloned lines of EC cells. However, when EC cells are induced to differentiate into large flat endodern-like cells (END cells), EGF receptors increase in number reaching a plateau in 6 to 8 days. At 8 to 10 days after induction, END cells multiply very slowly, but when EGF is added (3 x 10(-10) M) to the medium, cell division is stimulated and a further change in morphology occurs. This letter describes the binding characteristics and numbers of the EGF receptors on EC and END cells and shows that exogenous retinoic acid increases the numbers of EGF receptors on END cells. We were unable to find endogenous competing factors produced by EC cells. Such factors could account for the lack of detectable binding of EGF on these cells. As EC cells differentiate to END cells, so the ability of the cells to form tumours is reduced. Since this change is accompanied by an increase in the number of EGF receptors there may be a relationship between these two events.
abstract_ja: マウス奇形癌幹細胞(胎児性癌、すなわちEC細胞)は極微量のマウス上皮成長因子(EGF)を結合し、この因子は2株のクローン化EC細胞の増殖に刺激効果を示さない。しかし、EC細胞を大型で扁平な内胚葉様細胞(END細胞)に誘導すると、EGF受容体の数は増加し、6〜8日でプラトーに達する。誘導後8〜10日目のEND細胞は非常にゆっくり増殖するが、EGF(3×10⁻¹⁰M)を培地に添加すると細胞分裂が促進され、さらに形態変化が生じる。本レターは、EC細胞およびEND細胞のEGF受容体の結合特性と数を記載し、外因性レチノイン酸がEND細胞のEGF受容体数を増加させることを示す。EC細胞が産生する内因性の競合因子は見いだせなかった。EC細胞からEND細胞への変化に伴い細胞の腫瘍形成能は低下し、この変化がEGF受容体の増加を伴うことから、両事象の間に関連がある可能性がある。
